H5653G.name: Abda
H5653G.desc: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
H5653G.brief: Father of Adoram, who was over forced labor
H5653G.short: Abda was the father of Adoram (or 'Adoniram'), who was in charge of forced labor during Solomon's reign.

H5655.name: Abdeel
H5655.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H5655.brief: Father of Shelemiah, an official under King Jehoiakim
H5655.short: Abdeel was the father of Shelemiah, an official sent by King Jehoiakim to arrest Baruch and Jeremiah.

H5660G.name: Abdi
H5660G.desc: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H5660G.brief: A Levite, ancestor of Ethan the musician
H5660G.short: Abdi, a Levite, was an ancestor of Ethan, one of the musicians appointed by David to serve in the temple.

H5660H.name: Abdi
H5660H.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H5660H.short: Abdi, a Levite, was the father of Kish and served during the reign of King Hezekiah.

H5660I.name: Abdi
H5660I.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H5660I.brief: An Israelite who married a foreign wife
H5660I.short: Abdi, one of the descendants of Elam, was among those who agreed to put away their foreign wives during Ezra's time.

H5661.name: Abdiel
H5661.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H5661.short: Abdiel, son of Guni, was a chief of a Gadite family during the time of Jotham, king of Judah.

H5658I.name: Abdon
H5658I.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H5658I.short: Abdon was a son of Shashak and a member of the tribe of Benjamin.

H5658J.name: Abdon
H5658J.desc: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
H5658J.short: Abdon, the son of Abiel (or 'Jeiel') and brother of Ner, was a member of the Israelite community in Gibeon.

H5658H.name: Abdon
H5658H.brief: A minor judge of Israel from Ephraim
H5658H.short: Abdon, the son of Hillel the Pirathonite, was a minor Judge of Israel who led for eight years.

H5651H.name: Ebed
H5651H.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H5651H.brief: Descendant of Adin who returned with Ezra
H5651H.short: Ebed, a descendant of Adin, was among those who returned to Jerusalem with Ezra during the second wave of the return from Babylonian exile.

H5651G.name: Ebed
H5651G.brief: Father of Gaal, who opposed Abimelech's rule
H5651G.short: Ebed was the father of Gaal, who led a rebellion against Abimelech, the son of Gideon, in Shechem.

H5663.name: Ebed-melech
H5663.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H5663.brief: Ethiopian eunuch who rescued Jeremiah from a cistern
H5663.short: Ebed-melech, an Ethiopian eunuch in King Zedekiah's service, rescued the prophet Jeremiah from a cistern and was promised safety by God for his faith.

H5677H.name: Eber
H5677H.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H5677H.brief: A Gadite chief during the reign of Jotham
H5677H.short: Eber was a Gadite chief during the reign of Jotham, king of Judah, mentioned in the genealogy of Gad.

H5677I.name: Eber
H5677I.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H5677I.short: Eber was a son of Elpaal and a descendant of Benjamin, mentioned in the genealogy of the Benjamites.

H5677J.name: Eber
H5677J.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H5677J.short: Eber was a son of Shashak and a descendant of Benjamin, mentioned in the genealogy of the Benjamites.

H5677G.name: Eber
H5677G.desc: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
H5677G.brief: Ancestor of Abraham; father of Peleg and Joktan
H5677G.short: Eber was an ancestor of Abraham, the father of Peleg and Joktan, and the eponymous ancestor of the Hebrews.

H5677K.name: Eber
H5677K.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H5677K.brief: A priest during the time of Joiakim
H5677K.short: Eber was a priest who served during the time of Joiakim, the son of Jeshua, after the return from Babylonian exile.

H5698.name: Eglah
H5698.desc: Woman living at the time of United Monarchy
H5698.brief: David's wife and mother of Ithream
H5698.short: Eglah was one of David's wives and the mother of his son Ithream, born in Hebron.

H5680.name: Hebrews
H5680.desc: Eber@Gen.10.21-Luk   עֵבֶר (Eber, H5677)   People from Eber@Gen.10.21-Luk
H5680.brief: An ethnic group descended from Abraham.
H5680.short: The Hebrews were an ethnic group descended from Abraham, also known as Israelites or Jews.

H5681.name: Ibri
H5681.desc: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H5681.brief: A Levite of the family of Merari.
H5681.short: Ibri was a Levite of the family of Merari, mentioned in the context of the divisions of the Levitical priests during the reign of King David.

H5662L.name: Obadiah
H5662L.desc: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H5662L.short: Obadiah was a Gadite warrior who joined David at Ziklag when he was fleeing from Saul.

H5662M.name: Obadiah
H5662M.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H5662M.brief: Ruler over Zebulun in David's time
H5662M.short: Obadiah was the ruler over the tribe of Zebulun during the reign of King David.

H5662H.name: Obadiah
H5662H.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H5662H.short: Obadiah was a descendant of King David, mentioned in the genealogy of David's descendants.

H5662I.name: Obadiah
H5662I.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H5662I.short: Obadiah was one of the six sons of Azel, a descendant of King Saul.

H5662J.name: Obadiah
H5662J.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H5662J.short: Obadiah was one of the five sons of Izrahiah, a descendant of Issachar.

H5662K.name: Obadiah
H5662K.desc: Levite living at the time of Exile and Return
H5662K.short: Obadiah, also known as Abda, was a gatekeeper and descendant of Jeduthun who served in the temple.

H5662G.name: Obadiah
H5662G.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H5662G.short: Obadiah was a palace administrator under King Ahab who feared the Lord and protected a hundred prophets during Jezebel's persecution.

H5662N.name: Obadiah
H5662N.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H5662N.brief: Levite sent to teach in Judah
H5662N.short: Obadiah was a Levite sent by King Jehoshaphat to teach the Book of the Law in the cities of Judah.

H5662O.name: Obadiah
H5662O.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H5662O.short: Obadiah was a Levite who served as an overseer during the temple repairs under King Josiah.

H5662P.name: Obadiah
H5662P.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H5662P.short: Obadiah was one of the leaders who returned to Jerusalem from Babylonian exile with Ezra.

H5662Q.name: Obadiah
H5662Q.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H5662Q.short: Obadiah was one of the leaders who signed the covenant of faithfulness during Nehemiah's time.

H5662R.name: Obadiah
H5662R.desc: Prophet living at the time of Exile and Return
H5662R.short: Obadiah was a prophet who delivered a message of judgment against the nation of Edom.

H5654.name: Obed-edom
H5654.desc: Singer living at the time of United Monarchy
H5654.short: Obed-edom was a Gittite in whose house the Ark of the Covenant stayed for three months, bringing blessings to his household.

H5624.name: Sered
H5624.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H5624.brief: Son of Zebulun, ancestor of the Seredites
H5624.short: Sered was a son of Zebulun and the ancestor of the Seredite clan.

H5639.name: Sethur
H5639.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H5639.brief: Son of Michael, spy from the tribe of Asher
H5639.short: Sethur, the son of Michael, was one of the twelve spies sent by Moses to scout out the land of Canaan, representing the tribe of Asher.

H5644.name: Sithri
H5644.desc: Levite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H5644.brief: Son of Uzziel, a Levite of the Kohathite clan.
H5644.short: Sithri was a son of Uzziel, a Levite of the Kohathite clan, mentioned in the genealogy of the Levites.

H5618.name: Sophereth
H5618.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H5618.brief: Ancestor of a family of Solomon's servants who returned from exile.
H5618.short: Sophereth (or Hassophereth) was the ancestor of a family of Solomon's servants who were among the exiles that returned to Jerusalem from Babylon.

H5658G.name: Abdon
H5658G.brief: A Levitical city in the territory of Asher.
H5658G.short: Abdon, a town allotted to the Levites within the tribal territory of Asher.

H5684.name: Abronah
H5684.brief: A desert campsite during Israel's wilderness wanderings.
H5684.short: Abronah, an Israelite campsite between Jotbathah and Ezion-geber during the wilderness wanderings.

H5697B.name: Eglath-shelishiyah
H5697B.brief: Moabite city; its destruction prophesied by Isaiah and Jeremiah
H5697B.short: Eglath-shelishiyah, a Moabite city whose destruction was prophesied by Isaiah and Jeremiah.

H5611.name: Sephar
H5611.brief: Boundary of the territory settled by Joktan's descendants
H5611.short: Sephar was a mountain in the east that marked the boundary of the territory settled by the descendants of Joktan (<ref="Gen. 10:30">Gen. 10:30</ref>).

H5614.name: Sepharad
H5614.brief: City in Asia Minor; destination of exiled Jews
H5614.short: Sepharad, possibly referring to Sardis, was a destination of exiled Jews (<ref="Obad. 1:20">Obad. 1:20</ref>) and one of the seven churches mentioned in Revelation (<ref="Rev. 1:11; 3:1, 4">Rev. 1:11; 3:1, 4</ref>).

H5617.name: Sepharvaim
H5617.brief: City of origin for people resettled in Samaria
H5617.short: Sepharvaim was one of the cities from which the Assyrians brought people to resettle in Samaria after the deportation of the Israelites (<ref="2Ki. 17:24, 31; 18:34; 19:13; Isa. 36:19; 37:13">2Ki. 17:24, 31; 18:34; 19:13; Isa. 36:19; 37:13</ref>).

H5626.name: Sirah
H5626.brief: Place near Hebron where Abner was killed by Joab
H5626.short: Sirah, also called the Cistern of Sirah, was a place near Hebron where Joab killed Abner in revenge for the death of his brother Asahel (<ref="2Sam. 3:26">2Sam. 3:26</ref>).
